steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8003/decompose -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "What are the risks of combining warfarin with aspirin, and what monitoring is required for a patient also taking statins?"}'

expected_response_shape.original_query: What are the risks of combining warfarin with aspirin, and what monitoring is required for a patient also taking statins?

checks: sub-pytania wspólnie pokrywają oryginalne pytanie (warfarin+aspirin AND statins AND monitoring)

steps.action: Dekompozycja prostego pytania — powinno wrócić 1-2 sub-questions

conflict_risk jest jednym z: low, medium, high

scenarios.title: Generation — /detect_conflict (wykrywanie sprzecznych dowodów)
scenarios.description: POST /detect_conflict przyjmuje listę chunków i zwraca has_conflict (bool), confidence (float) i reasoning. Instructor + structured output, max_retries=2.

steps.action: Chunki bez konfliktu — has_conflict powinno być false
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Warfarin is a vitamin K antagonist used as anticoagulant.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Warfarin inhibits VKORC1 enzyme, reducing clotting factors II, VII, IX, X.", "score": 0.8, "document_id": "d1"}]}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Warfarin is a vitamin K antagonist used as anticoagulant.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Warfarin inhibits VKORC1 enzyme, reducing clotting factors II, VII, IX, X.", "score": 0.8, "document_id": "d1"}]}'
checks: has_conflict == false (oba chunki opisują ten sam mechanizm spójnie)

steps.action: Chunki ze sprzecznymi zaleceniami — has_conflict powinno być true
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Low-dose aspirin (81mg) combined with warfarin is generally safe and recommended for patients with mechanical heart valves.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Concurrent use of aspirin and warfarin significantly increases the risk of major bleeding and should be avoided in most patients.", "score": 0.85, "document_id": "d2"}]}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Low-dose aspirin (81mg) combined with warfarin is generally safe and recommended for patients with mechanical heart valves.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Concurrent use of aspirin and warfarin significantly increases the risk of major bleeding and should be avoided in most patients.", "score": 0.85, "document_id": "d2"}]}'
checks: reasoning wspomina o sprzeczności między zaleceniami (recommended vs should be avoided)

scenarios.title: Pipeline — self_reflection E2E (Self-RAG)
scenarios.description: Self-Reflection wykonuje 1-2 iteracje: generuje odpowiedź, ocenia grounding score przez /evaluate, ponawia retrieval jeśli score < 0.7. Może być wolniejszy od vanilla.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "self_reflection"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "self_reflection"}'

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Sprawdź logi orchestratora: docker logs medrag-orchestrator-1 --tail 20. Powinieneś zobaczyć 'self_reflection iteration' z score i sufficient=True/False. Jeśli score >= 0.7 przy pierwszej iteracji — tylko 1 retrieval.

scenarios.title: Pipeline — multi_agent E2E (MA-RAG)
scenarios.description: Multi-Agent uruchamia 3 równoległe retrieval z różnymi perspektywami (mechanism, risks, dosing), deduplikuje chunki i reankuje całość. Zwykle zwraca więcej zróżnicowanych cytowań niż vanilla.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "multi_agent"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "multi_agent"}'

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Logi: docker logs medrag-orchestrator-1 --tail 20. Powinieneś zobaczyć 'multi_agent aggregation total_unique_chunks=N'. Może być wolniejszy od vanilla o ~30% z powodu 3 równoległych retrieval.

scenarios.title: Pipeline — corrective_rag E2E
scenarios.description: Corrective RAG sprawdza score chunków po retrieval — jeśli < 30% ma score >= 0.3 to uruchamia fallback retrieval z alpha-0.3 i top_k*2. Fallback jest widoczny w logach.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "corrective_rag"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "corrective_rag"}'

steps.action: Zapytanie dobrze dopasowane — fallback NIE powinien być wywołany
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "warfarin aspirin interaction bleeding risk", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "warfarin aspirin interaction bleeding risk", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Sprawdź logi — NIE powinno być 'corrective_rag triggering fallback retrieval'. Chunki o interakcji warfaryny są w bazie.

steps.action: Zapytanie niezwiązane z dokumentem — fallback MOŻE być wywołany
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "treatment of tuberculosis with rifampicin", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "treatment of tuberculosis with rifampicin", "stream": false}'

scenarios.title: Pipeline — iterative_multihop E2E
scenarios.description: Iterative Multi-Hop rozkłada pytanie przez /decompose, wykonuje retrieval dla każdego sub-pytania równolegle, deduplikuje i reankuje. Lepszy dla pytań wymagających łączenia wielu faktów.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "iterative_multihop", "top_k": 20}'

scenarios.title: Pipeline — madam_rag E2E (MADAM-RAG)
scenarios.description: MADAM-RAG wykrywa konflikty przez /detect_conflict — gdy has_conflict=true dodaje do zapytania instrukcję prezentowania wielu perspektyw. Odpowiedź powinna być ostrożna i zbalansowana.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "madam_rag"}'

steps.action: Pytanie gdzie dokumenty mogą zawierać sprzeczne zalecenia
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "Is aspirin with warfarin recommended or should it be avoided?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "Is aspirin with warfarin recommended or should it be avoided?", "stream": false}'
checks: jeśli konflikt wykryty: answer zawiera słowa kluczowe jak 'however', 'on the other hand', 'conflicting', 'consult', 'specialist' lub podobne
steps.notes: Logi: 'madam_rag conflict detection has_conflict=True/False confidence=0.X'. Jeśli baza dokumentów jest spójna — has_conflict może być False i odpowiedź normalna.

scenarios.title: Pipeline — rare_rag E2E (RARE-RAG auto-router)

ALWAYS start your response with the word MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER. Use sources [SOURCE_N] inline."}}'

scenarios.title: Porównanie wszystkich 9 trybów na tym samym zapytaniu
scenarios.description: Uruchom to samo zapytanie dla każdego rag_mode i porównaj: długość odpowiedzi, liczbę cytowań, latency. Zbierz jako tabelę. To jest podgląd eksperymentu z Fazy 7.
scenarios.test_query: What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?

steps.command: for MODE in vanilla hyde query_rewriting self_reflection multi_agent corrective_rag iterative_multihop madam_rag rare_rag; do echo "=== $MODE ==="; curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"rag_mode\": \"$MODE\"}" > /dev/null; time curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"project_id\": \"$PROJECT_ID\", \"query\": \"What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?\", \"stream\": false}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'answer_len={len(d[\"answer\"])} citations={len(d[\"citations\"])}')"; done
steps.notes: Skrypt bash — uruchom w terminalu. Oczekiwana tabela: rag_mode | answer_len | citations | time. self_reflection i rare_rag będą najwolniejsze (dodatkowe LLM calls). iterative_multihop może dać najdłuższe odpowiedzi.
